about.title: Santa Monica Wrongful Death Claims
about.longDescription: Five people died in Santa Monica traffic collisions in 2025, out of 445 injury crashes recorded citywide. Each of those numbers is a family learning how to move through Los Angeles County's courts while grieving. Wrongful death law in California exists for this moment: it lets a spouse, domestic partner, or child (and in some cases other dependents or heirs) bring a civil claim when someone's negligence took a life on Pacific Coast Highway, Lincoln Boulevard, 4th Street, or the Santa Monica Freeway. That claim is separate from any criminal case. Prosecutors decide whether to charge a driver; only the family can pursue funeral and burial costs, the income the person would have provided, and the harder-to-measure loss of love, companionship, and guidance. The clock matters. Most claims must be filed within two years of the date of death, and the window shrinks when a city, county, or state agency is involved. LawProactive is not a law firm. We are a free service that pairs Santa Monica families with an independent attorney who handles these cases on contingency.

whyChoose.title: Why Santa Monica Families Turn to LawProactive

items.title: Clarity on who can file
items.desc: California limits wrongful death standing to a spouse or domestic partner and children first, then certain dependents and heirs. The attorney we connect you with will explain where your family fits before anything else moves forward.

items.title: Deadlines handled early
items.desc: The general two-year limit runs from the date of death, but claims involving a government entity carry a much shorter notice period. Getting an attorney involved early protects that window.

items.title: Every category of loss considered
items.desc: Recoverable damages go beyond funeral and burial expenses to include lost financial support and the loss of love, companionship, and guidance. A contingency-fee attorney evaluates all of it, with no fee unless there is a recovery.

items.question: My family member was killed by a driver who is facing criminal charges. Do we still need a civil claim?
items.answer: Yes, the two are separate. A criminal case is brought by the district attorney to punish the driver, and it does not compensate your family. A wrongful death claim is a civil action your family controls, and it can proceed whether or not charges are filed or result in a conviction.

items.question: The crash happened on a Santa Monica city street. Does that change anything?
items.answer: It can. If a city, county, or state agency is potentially responsible, for example because of a government-owned vehicle or a road maintenance issue, California requires a formal claim within a much shorter period than the standard two years. Speaking with an attorney soon after the loss is the safest way to preserve every option.

items.question: How does LawProactive work, and what does it cost?
items.answer: LawProactive is a free connection service, not a law firm. We match Santa Monica families with an independent wrongful death attorney who works on contingency, meaning no fee unless there is a recovery. You are under no obligation after the initial conversation.
